zh: 本书记录了许许多多热爱并敬仰阿尔弗雷德的人所经历的一段重大而悲伤的时光，而对我与我的儿子罗汉，以及阿尔弗雷德的双亲来说，那更是一段天崩地裂的日子。阿尔弗雷德刚一确诊罹患不治之症，便着手撰写最后一章；在随后的几周里，他花了相当多的时间就本书的身后出版给出明确的指示。他对牛津大学出版社的彼得·莫姆奇洛夫怀有绝对的信任，此前一直与他联络。我乐于记下：阿尔弗雷德在手稿寄出仅三天后便辞世，在他辞世后数月里，这份信任被证明完全有据。除两幅与第8章有关的插图外，本书以阿尔弗雷德留下的原貌面世。它实际上是一份初稿，写于1996年复活节假期里紧张的三周之中。阿尔弗雷德本打算把许多照片插图亲手画出来，并在病倒前不久已开始为修订手稿做笔记。他禀有一种无可动摇的知足与幽默，庆幸且感激自己还有足够的时间赶着写完一本关于艺术的书——艺术正是真正令他着迷并令他愉悦的主题——并对最终成果感到满意。
en: This book chronicles a momentous and sad time for the many people who loved and admired Alfred, and a cataclysmic one for me and my son Rohan, and for Alfred's parents. Alfred began the final chapter directly upon receiving confirmation of an incurable condition; in the weeks that followed he devoted considerable time towards giving clear instructions concerning its posthumous publication. He had absolute confidence in Peter Momtchiloff of Oxford University Press, with whom he had previously liaised. It gives me pleasure to record that this confidence was amply justified in the months following Alfred's death just three days after the posting of the manuscript. With the exception of two illustrations pertaining to Chapter 8 the book appears in the form in which Alfred left it. It amounts to a first draft written during an intense three-week period over the Easter vacation of 1996. Alfred intended to draw with his own hand many of the photographic illustrations and had begun to make notes towards the revision of the manuscript shortly before he was taken ill. Blessed with implacable contentment and good humour, he was pleased and grateful for being granted time enough in which to squeeze completion of a book on art-the subject that truly gripped and delighted him-and was satisfied with the final product.

zh: 必须说明，这里列出的人们都是合作者，他们为确保本书顺利出版所付出的心力，虽在性质上与我的不同，却都源于他们与阿尔弗雷德直接的个人交往。斯蒂芬与克里斯汀·休·琼斯曾与阿尔弗雷德同窗。斯蒂芬花了许多时间扫描插图，以便手稿能在阿尔弗雷德在世时寄给出版社。他与此同时还细心关切地照看着罗汉，并与克里斯汀一道，在阿尔弗雷德最后的几周里给予他坦露情意的陪伴。阿尔弗雷德向来不乏言辞上的回应，但当他注意到斯蒂芬投入了如此多的工作时，却意味深长地沉默了。尼古拉斯·托马斯与阿尔弗雷德曾享有相互激发的思想伙伴关系，多年来发展为亲密的友谊：可以公允地说，在与出版过程有关的一切事务上，他所起的作用与我同样积极。克里斯·平尼给予了持续的精神与智识支持，迈克尔·奥汉隆则安排了大英博物馆所藏插图的相关授权。阿尔弗雷德与我的其他朋友，即唐·加德纳、卡丽·汉弗莱、埃里克·赫希、玛丽琳·斯特拉森、苏珊娜·库希勒与霍华德·莫菲，处理了出版过程中出现的各种疑问。阿尔弗雷德的母亲苏珊·盖尔与特鲁迪·宾斯根据阿尔弗雷德的草图重绘了部分插图。
en: It must be made clear that the people listed herein were collaborators whose commitment to ensuring the book's smooth publication, while different in nature from mine, arose out of a direct personal involvement with Alfred. Stephen and Christine Hugh Jones had been at school with Alfred. Stephen devoted many hours of his time to scanning the illustrations so that the manuscript could be sent to the publishers while Alfred was alive. He combined this with keeping a watchful, solicitous eye over Rohan and, in common with Christine, with providing Alfred with an openly affectionate companionship during his last weeks. Alfred, never at a loss to respond verbally, was significantly silent when it came to his notice that Stephen was putting in so much work. Nicholas Thomas and Alfred had enjoyed a mutually stimulating intellectual partnership that evolved into a close friendship over many years: it would be fair to say that he has taken as active a role as mine in all matters relating to the publication process. Chris Pinney gave constant moral and intellectual support and Michael O'Hanlon arranged for permissions in relation to the illustrations held at the British Museum. Other friends of Alfred's and mine, namely Don Gardner, Carrie Humphrey, Eric Hirsch, Marilyn Strathern, Suzanne Kuchler, and Howard Morphy, attended to various queries that came up in the course of publication. Susan Gell, Alfred's mother, and Trudi Binns redrew some of the illustrations from rough sketches of Alfred's.

zh: 出于与上述各位不同的缘由，我要感谢那些回应了我的求助的人：安妮塔·赫尔利、唐·曼宁、保罗·考德威尔、艾丹·贝克、艾莉森·迪普罗斯与马杜·坎纳。以下机构慷慨地免除了通常的复制费用：伦敦大英博物馆；巴黎人类博物馆；剑桥哈登博物馆；布拉格纳普尔斯泰克亚洲、非洲与美洲文化博物馆；莱顿国立民族学博物馆；以及纽伦堡日耳曼国家博物馆。最后，我要记下我对牛津大学出版社罗伯特·里特的一份个人的感激。作为负责制作一部复杂图书的人，罗伯特始终如一的体贴、耐心与对我的热忱，令我深受感动。
en: On grounds different from those for the people mentioned above, I would like to thank those who responded to my requests for help: Anita Hurley, Don Manning, Paul Caldwell, Aidan Baker, Alison Deeprose, and Madhu Khanna. The following institutions generously waived normal reproduction charges: The British Museum, London; Musée de l’Homme, Paris; Haddon Museum, Cambridge; Naprstek Museum of Asian, African and American Culture, Prague; Rijksmuseum voor Volkenkunde, Leiden; and Germanisches Nationalmuseum, Nuremberg. And finally, I wish to record a personal debt I owe to Robert Ritter of Oxford University Press. As the person in charge of producing a complicated book, Robert has impressed me by his constant sensitivity, patience, and warmth towards me.
